portInfo.description: Sydney Harbour cruise calls are administered by Port Authority of NSW, whose Cruise section lists dedicated FAQ hubs for the Overseas Passenger Terminal and White Bay Cruise Terminal, plus a Sydney Harbour cruise schedule and NSW-wide cruise policies. OPT sits in the Circular Quay precinct; White Bay is a separate harbour facility typically requiring a transfer. Numeric berth LOA/depth were not pulled from the FAQ pages captured (some deep FAQ URLs 404’d), so metrics stay null.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: OPT guests often walk into Circular Quay; White Bay needs bus/taxi — confirm which terminal your ship uses.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Bondi or ferry to Manly — timed returns.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Check OPT vs White Bay on the ship’s daily program before planning a walk-off.
